paper_container: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
question: On FOREAGENT's exact released prediction grid, how much do published pair-row micro accuracy, task-macro accuracy and the DeepSeek-versus-GPT comparison change under graph-rank/UST weighting on one common finite directional support?

prior_alignment_audit_failure_reasons: The frozen confidence-coverage gate failed for DeepSeek although directional prediction coverage was complete.
Only 22 of 26 tasks met the frozen quartile support threshold.

not_computed_or_read_before_freeze: exact common finite alignment-support vertices, components, incidence rank or cycle rows
exact common-support edge and task weight total variation
DeepSeek or GPT UST rank-micro accuracy
DeepSeek or GPT UST task-macro accuracy
disclosure.classification_policy: Deterministic post-disclosure sensitivity only. No confirmatory success label or result-dependent threshold is permitted. The prior INSUFFICIENT-SUPPORT decision is immutable.

support.deepseek_grid: Exact intersection is required to equal each of the three released pair grids within every task.
support.gpt_grid: Use the three-release intersection within task; retain and report the eight excluded incomplete triplicate pairs.
support.cross_model_grid: Intersect the two model grids within each task.
support.directional_filter: Remove only nonfinite-score and exact-score-tie pairs before graph construction. Invalid prediction indices receive zero correctness, matching the prior audit; confidence never controls inclusion.
support.truth_consistency: Scores, metric direction and the score-derived winner must agree across releases and models on common support.
support.release_aggregation: Average the three binary correctness values within model-task-pair before any graph or task aggregation.

estimands.raw_pair_micro: Uniform average over exact common-support pair rows.
estimands.ust_rank_micro: Weight every common-support edge by b_e^T L^+ b_e within its task-connected component, then divide by the total endpoint-incidence rank. Tasks therefore receive total weight equal to their graph rank.
estimands.raw_task_macro: Uniform pair average within each task followed by an equal average over 26 tasks.
estimands.ust_task_macro: UST-weighted edge average within each task followed by an equal average over 26 tasks.
estimands.paired_model_delta: Compute DeepSeek-minus-GPT correctness on the same pair before all four aggregations.
estimands.common_graph: The graph is built only once on the exact cross-model common finite support, so both models use identical edges and weights.
estimands.interpretation: UST rank-micro is the expected edge accuracy on one uniform spanning basis per connected component. It is an alternative graph-basis sensitivity, not a universally correct replacement for the paper's row-population estimand.

inference.task_bootstrap: Resample the 26 tasks with replacement. Recompute ratio estimands from sampled task numerators and denominators rather than averaging precomputed global ratios.
inference.leave_one_task_out: Report minimum, maximum and sign count for every point estimand with a fixed 1e-10 sign tolerance.

mandatory_outputs: exact reproduction of the prior per-model raw pair-micro and task-macro values on each model's released support
common-support graph rows, vertices, components, incidence rank, cycle rows and complete/incomplete component counts
Foster residual, edge-weight range, bridge count, edge-distribution TV and task-weight TV
all four common-support metrics with task-clustered intervals for both models
UST-minus-raw rank-micro and task-macro shifts with intervals
paired DeepSeek-minus-GPT versions of all metrics
all negative, null or direction-reversing results

independent_implementations.producer_graph: Symmetric Laplacian eigendecomposition and Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse.
independent_implementations.verifier_graph: Independent adjacency/DFS components and grounded reduced-Laplacian inverse.
synthetic_controls: K_4 has every edge weight 1/2 and total rank 3.
A tree has every edge weight 1.
A triangle plus bridge has nonuniform weights and a known rank deficit.
Reversing pair position does not change truth or correctness.
A missing prediction receives zero correctness without reading confidence.
Incomplete GPT triplicates are intersected before common support.
Nonfinite truth is removed before graph construction.
Near-zero LOTO signs use a shared fixed tolerance.

established: FOREAGENT explicitly uses exhaustive pair generation and micro-averaged pair accuracy.
Effective resistance equals uniform-spanning-tree edge inclusion probability.
Foster's theorem makes total edge leverage equal graph incidence rank.
Graph-resistance error analysis and optimal design for pairwise comparisons predate this work.
related_work_boundary.allowed_claim: A reproducible MLE benchmark sensitivity showing whether combinatorial pair-row weighting is outcome-material on a directly competing released corpus.
forbidden_claims: effective sample size or independent-label count
invalidity of FOREAGENT's 6x agent-level acceleration or +6 percent gain
reclassification of the prior INSUFFICIENT-SUPPORT audit

integrity.failure_policy: Any source hash, schema, support, truth, duplicate, graph, arithmetic, identity, test, trace or byte mismatch stops without scientific interpretation.
